entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a small desert house. One small, cube-shaped, single-storey whitewashed house with a flat roof and a low parapet, a small square wind-catcher tower on one corner of the roof, a dark wooden horseshoe-arch door with a turquoise cloth awning above it and one small window with a carved wooden screen.

style.suffix: Whitewashed mudbrick walls on a warm sandstone base, flat roofs with low parapets, horseshoe arches, carved timber screens and beams. Chunky low-poly shapes, hard edges, flat faces. Isolated building, no ground, no text, no characters.
